overview: Assassin Lin Mimi, determined to kill the feared demon Ye Xun, unexpectedly becomes his bride, forcing them into a reluctant partnership that gradually turns into love as they face traitors, rival clans, and hidden conspiracies in the martial arts world.
name: 这个江湖不一般

overview: Shao Yu, a father forced to complete deadly missions to save his kidnapped daughter. With a bomb implanted in his body, he uncovers a dark conspiracy involving a powerful billionaire’s son hiding sinister crimes. As the clock ticks, Shao races through explosive challenges to expose the truth and rescue his child.
name: Rescue the Girl

overview: Aliyans is a popular Malayalam-language sitcom that airs on Kaumudy TV. The show, directed by Rajesh Thalachira, premiered on February 24, 2020, and is a sequel to the sitcom Aliyan vs Aliyan. The story is set in Thiruvananthapuram and revolves around the life of Ratnamma and her family. It highlights the daily incidents and the love-hate relationship between two brothers-in-law, Kanakan and Cleatus. Most episodes focus on Cleatus getting into trouble due to his ill-conceived ideas, with Kanakan often coming to his rescue.
name: Brother-in-Laws

overview: The animation  "Ling Tian Du Zun" is adapted from the web novel of the same name by Qimao's contracted writer You Mu. Ling Tian, a sword saint of his generation, went against the will of heaven to seize the stele in order to save his beloved, but was plotted against by the way of heaven. When he fell, he perished together with the way of heaven, but was unexpectedly reborn, returning to the moment of his death three hundred years ago when his dantian was completely destroyed and his sword bone was taken away. His beauty is still there, his old enemy is still there, and he has been on the long road to becoming a saint, so why not start over? In this life, he vows to rewrite his destiny and make up for his regrets!
name: Ling Tian Du Zun

overview: Jen Psaki tackles the biggest issues of the week and features one-on-one interviews with newsmakers.
name: The Briefing with Jen Psaki

overview: Colonel Mir Ata Khan, a Qara Soran officer who makes her living by trapping bandits, along with her military family members, go to a cursed hunting ground to carry out an important mission! ...
name: Hunting Ground

original_name: 海老だって鯛が釣りたい
overview: A self-doubting woman battles life’s lows while desperately searching for her perfect “big catch” in this heartfelt romantic comedy.
name: Ebi Datte Tai ga Tsuritai

overview: It’s a talk show like no other: one question, two guests and the man everyone agrees is this country’s least experienced interviewer. The question? If your house was about to be destroyed, what two things would you save?
name: Shaun Micallef's Eve of Destruction
